pipeline_warnings: Source size not trusted: at its file units the source is 168.72 cm tall; it was rescaled to a chosen height of 30.0 cm (effective source_units_to_m=0.177814). glTF units are metres, but the GLB measures 1.56 m tall x 1.54 m wide x 1.69 m deep (Blender Z-up), a nonsensical size for a house cat (generated meshes come out normalised to ~1.5-2 units). Rescaled to a chosen 30 cm sitting height (plausible domestic cat, head + ears). This is a guess, not a measurement: needs human confirmation of the intended in-game size.

Source topology is not clean (after welding coincident verts): 49 non-manifold edges, 231 open boundary edges, 66 non-manifold verts, 7 separate parts (vert counts [1359, 20, 11, 10, 6, 4, 3]). Unwelded as imported: 2380 boundary edges, 277 parts.
Source is already low-poly (2,680 tris), at or below the LOD0 budget (3,000); LOD budgets were set relative to the source, not to a 'high-poly to game-res' reduction.
Static mesh only: the source has no rig/armature and the pipeline does not do skinning (step 'skinning' = not_implemented).
ORM roughness (G=0.6) and metallic (B=0.0) are constants, not measured; only R (AO) is baked.

Base colour is a bake transfer of the source texture (texture_20250901) onto LOD0's new UVs: it carries the source texture's blotches/baked-in lighting, and texels whose rays missed the source were black (1.419% of the UV-covered area in the raw bake; 0.0% after neighbour fill + dilation; filled texels are guessed colour, not source data).
LOD0 has 28 UV-flipped faces (Smart UV Project).
Retopo proxy needed repair: 298 faces on non-manifold edges removed and holes filled before QuadriFlow (bake still uses the untouched sculpt).

[manual review of previews] Exported height is 28.9 cm, not 30 cm: the source was normalised to exactly 30.0 cm on Z, but QuadriFlow rounds off the ear tips (~1.1 cm). Only one ear-tip piece was recovered as detail geometry; it shows as a small dark sliver on that ear in the back view.

[manual review of previews] Whiskers: kept as separate thin source geometry on LOD0 only (7 whisker fans + 1 ear tip + 1 tail piece = 9 detail pieces, 469 tris; 43 faces on non-manifold whisker edges removed). One lower whisker cluster was classed 'inside the body' and dropped. LOD1-3 drop the whiskers (469 tris > 25% of their budgets); there they show only as dark dashes in the baked BC.

[manual review of previews] Bell: NOT separate geometry. The detail filter classed the bell pieces as a surface patch (max 1.4% of height off the body), so the bell is the finer remeshed body (2,476 body tris vs 1,353 quads in pass 1) + baked BC/normal. It reads as a separate gold bell under the collar on LOD0/LOD1 but is flatter than the source.

[manual review of previews] Back of the rump/tail base: a dark torn cavity remains. The SOURCE mesh is torn there (open holes and loose red shards in the source back render) and QuadriFlow preserves those boundaries. The BC texel holes are filled (black texels inside the UV mask: 1.42% raw bake -> 0.0% after fill), but the cavity is geometry, not texture.
[manual review of previews] A small spike/shard hangs below the front paws on LOD0-LOD3 (inherited from loose source shards through the remesh proxy).
[manual review of previews] Filled BC texels are guessed colour (neighbour average), not source data. 28 LOD0 faces are flipped in UV space (Smart UV Project on whisker strips).
Unreal import not tested: the LodGroup in the combined FBX is written via a runtime patch to Blender's exporter and has only been verified by re-importing into Blender.
